mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(TEAM_SN) AS code, TEAM_NM AS name FROM TB_TEAM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEPT_CD = 'DP030' ORDER BY TEAM_SN
SELECT CD AS code, CD_NM AS name FROM TB_COM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = 'SCHSE' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
mapper.sql: S.SCHDL_SN AS id, TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS eventDate, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'HH24:MI') = '00:00' THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(S.SCHDL_BGNG_DT, 'HH24:MI') END AS timeText, S.SCHDL_TTL AS title, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS kindCd, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, S.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SCHDL S JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = S.TEAM_SN WHERE S.SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND S.TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND S.AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCHDL (TEAM_SN, SCHDL_SE_CD, SCHDL_TTL, SCHDL_BGNG_DT, AUTO_REG_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{teamSn}, #{kindCd}, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'N', #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCHDL SET SCHDL_SE_CD = #{kindCd}, SCHDL_TTL = #{title}, SCHDL_BGNG_DT = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SCHDL WHERE SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND AUTO_REG_YN = 'N'
